title: Gene E. Robinson: One Million Honey Bees
content: At eighteen, Gene E. Robinson was spending time on a kibbutz in Israel harvesting grapefruit, and he longed for something less monotonus and more engaging. When offered the chance to help in a honey bee apiary, he leapt at it—and found himself captivated. The hum of the hives, the intricate order of their activity, and the intelligence of their collective behavior struck him with unexpected force. Standing amid the buzz and motion, he sensed a new world opening before him. In that moment, Robinson discovered the fascination that would shape his life’s work: understanding the mystery and marvel of the honey bee.
